About Sakhrat Al Janoub Contracting Co.

"Your Trusted Construction Partner"

Sakhrat Al Janoub Contracting Co. is a leading construction company specializing in road infrastructure, building design, and comprehensive construction solutions. With over 6 years of experience, we have established ourselves as a reliable partner in the Saudi construction industry.

Our Mission

Our Vision
